text:
maya: quick sync — proposing per-cardclass max-tokens-per-batch to reduce KV-fragmentation and kernel fallthroughs observed in the last two profiling runs. wanted to run numbers by the team before I open a rollout PR.

sandeep: do you have the perf numbers handy? last fix for A100 had a weird tail increase.

maya: attached summary from perf-bot below. TL;DR: at large token batches we see: increased kernel fallbacks on L4/A10, KV cache churn on T4, and lower utilization on A100 when mixing long and short sequences. H100 remains stable but benefits from higher batch token density.

perf-bot: profiling dump (summary):

```
workload: production-sim-2026-03
models: 13B-chat-v2 (kv-friendly), 70B-chat-v1
cardclasses: L4, T4, A10, A100, H100
metric: p50/p95 latency (ms), tokens_per_batch, kernel_fallback_rate, kv_fragmentation_pct

results (sample):
L4  : p50=42  p95=220 tokens=6k  kb_fallback=7%  kv_frag=12%
T4  : p50=58  p95=340 tokens=4k  kb_fallback=4%  kv_frag=18%
A10 : p50=38  p95=210 tokens=9k  kb_fallback=9%  kv_frag=15%
A100: p50=30  p95=190 tokens=18k kb_fallback=3%  kv_frag=9%
H100: p50=28  p95=170 tokens=22k kb_fallback=2%  kv_frag=7%

notes:
- High tokens_per_batch correlates with lower p50 but some p95 regressions when kernel fallback occurs.
- KV fragmentation spikes on T4 when tokens_per_batch > 5k (likely memory allocator + small-LLM kv layout).
```

li: nice. what's the concrete proposal?

maya: proposal (soft caps + per-card hard ceilings):
- Introduce `slot_window_soft_token_target` and `card_hard_token_ceiling` in runtime config.
- Soft target used for batch formation prioritizer (can be exceeded briefly, scores penalty).
- Hard ceiling enforced at enqueue to avoid kernel fallbacks and extreme KV frag.

numbers I want to try (initial A/B):
- L4: soft_target=5k, hard_ceiling=7k
- T4: soft_target=4k, hard_ceiling=5.5k
- A10: soft_target=10k, hard_ceiling=12k
- A100: soft_target=20k, hard_ceiling=24k
- H100: soft_target=24k, hard_ceiling=30k

priya: rationale? those are higher than some previous runs for A10. how do we prevent p95 regressions?

maya: two levers: 1) penalize mixing long/short requests in the same slice unless the score is high (entropy-aware packing), 2) kernel-fit hinting: when batch tokens exceed model-specific kernel-fit thresholds, prefer alternate kernel that reduces fallbacks but costs a bit more cycles.

sandeep: can we get a quick simulation run across the real request distribution? last time simulations missed the mix-heavy tail (few large requests caused most issues).

maya: yes — I queued an offline sim (sampled 48h prod traces) with the soft/hard config above. perf-bot posted the run 30m ago. summary: overall cost/token down 6%, p50 down 8%, p95 for L4/A10 up ~4-6% in pathological mixes, but kernel fallback rate drops 60% vs prior naive high-ceiling config.

perf-bot: sim-summary: tokens_saved=6.1%, p50_change=-8.2%, p95_change_by_cardclass={L4:+5.1%,T4:+2.3%,A10:+4.8%,A100:-1.5%,H100:-2.0%}, kernel_fallback_rate_change=-60%

tom: curious about KV frag windows — do soft targets help TTL of cached prefixes?

maya: yes — by avoiding massive single-batch KV inserts on T4/L4 we reduce tiny key churn. we also propose a small KV prefetch throttle: when KV frag > 10% on a cardclass, throttle batch growth aggressiveness for new slices by 30%.

li: does this require runtime kernel changes or only scheduler heuristics?

maya: mostly scheduler heuristics + config knobs. kernel hinting is just a flag we already have in dev branch that switches to fallback-safe kernels when flagged. no new kernels for this rollout.

priya: rollout plan? can we do canary by region or by cardclass pool?

maya: propose two-phase:
1) Cardclass canary: enable soft_target + hard_ceiling on a small fleet per cardclass (10% nodes) for 48h, monitor p95 and kernel_fallback_rate.
2) Region canary where cardclass mix differs (EU vs US) for additional 48h.

config snippet to apply (will open PR):

```json
{
  "scheduler": {
    "slot_window_soft_token_targets": {"L4": 5000, "T4": 4000, "A10": 10000, "A100": 20000, "H100": 24000},
    "card_hard_token_ceilings": {"L4": 7000, "T4": 5500, "A10": 12000, "A100": 24000, "H100": 30000},
    "entropy_packing_penalty": 0.6,
    "kv_frag_throttle_threshold_pct": 10,
    "kv_frag_batch_grow_penalty_pct": 30
  }
}
```

sandeep: sounds reasonable. add a quick rollback trigger: if p95 increases >10% for any cardclass or kernel_fallback_rate rises unexpectedly. also add per-model gates for very large models (70B) to never exceed 50% of hard_ceiling.

maya: yep will add automated rollback + model gate.

priya: one more ask — in the PR include a short runbook: how to inspect kv_fragmentation_pct, where to dump kernel selection traces, and the perf-bot queries used. saves on-call time.

maya: will do. thanks all — i'll open the PR with the sim artifacts and the new config plus the canary job manifest. ping @sandeep @li for review once up. :rocket:
